scene.metaphor: A tiny nocturnal alchemy bench where local word-count beads are distilled into a compact learning engine while an oversized distant server monolith stays unplugged in the background.
scene.setting: A polished studio tabletop set built like a miniature data cellar: cool-gray felt floor, matte slate walls fading into generous negative space, one lateral workbench stretching across a wide frame, with a faint cobalt horizon and mint instrument glow.
scene.frozen_incident: Tal is calmly turning a small hand crank as a paper hopper spills tidy token beads into a glass chamber; the chamber is just beginning to pulse, and a few beads are hopping sideways into a second tube that clearly shows the ‘concat and fine-tune’ handoff. Behind him, a giant but idle server block is draped in shadow, making the tiny machine feel deliberately sufficient.
physical_materials: one restrained warm accent in Tal's coral tank top
scene.image_instruction: Create a serious polished studio photograph of Tal Perry as a recognizable operator in a miniature ML lab set. Use his curly dark hair, salt-and-pepper beard, and easy smile, dressed in a coral sleeveless top as the only warm accent. He stands left of center at a low brass hand crank, calmly feeding a shallow tray of hand-cut paper token cards into a clear glass chamber; the chamber glows mint and sends a few ivory beads through a second tube toward a small slate vector block, making the pretrain-to-concat-to-finetune idea physically literal. Keep the set tactile and handmade: cool-gray felt ground, slate backdrop, cobalt wire, waxed thread, and three large supporting props maximum. In the far right background, show a much larger server monolith in shadow, unplugged and ignored. Lighting should be crisp studio key with soft rim light, high tonal separation, and lots of negative space. Compose laterally for a 3:1 banner, with one dominant silhouette that still reads at 120x90.
